name: Sucrose Esters & Sucroglycerides
title: Sucrose Esters & Sucroglycerides
description: A pair of emulsifier/texturiser entries in the current EU list: sucrose esters of fatty acids (E473) and sucroglycerides (E474).
what_is: A pair of emulsifier/texturiser entries in the current EU list: sucrose esters of fatty acids (E473) and sucroglycerides (E474).
why_botia: BOTIA groups E473–E474 because the original audit range E473–E475 crosses into a different family: E475 is polyglycerol esters of fatty acids and is covered separately. Keeping the range precise prevents one ingredient family from swallowing another.
can_1: Detect E473, E474, sucrose esters of fatty acids and sucroglycerides.
can_2: Show the texture and E-number context while keeping E475 in the polyglycerol-esters card.
cannot_1: Determine concentration or the fatty-acid composition from the ingredient name.
cannot_2: Classify E475 as a sucrose ester.
